omp.note: `tested` is the list for omp-session-control and omp-services; omp-private-relay and omp-dashboard list theirs as `ompTested` under `plugins`. Only listed versions have been run. Newer versions are expected to work but are untested until listed.

bun.note: For running the tests only. omp 18.18.0 embeds Bun 1.4.4, which is what the extension runs on.

ompApi: ExtensionContext.mode, agent.kind, sessionManager.getSessionId, isIdle, abort, ui.notify

ompInternals.use: lookup('disabledExtensions').get and .listen with ExtensionAPI.pi.settings, to close control when the extension is disabled live
ompInternals.ifMissing: control still works, but a live disabledExtensions edit no longer closes the socket until the session ends or the off file is used; the extension reports this once when control starts and in /session-control status

ompInternals.use: getPluginSettings, to read the stored controlDir and idleTimeoutMs

omp-services.note: The command line also reads omp's cached marketplace catalog (<plugins root>/cache/marketplaces/<name>/marketplace.json), found from the installPath that `omp plugin list --json` reports.

omp-private-relay.runtime: The Bun embedded in omp (BUN_BE_BUN=1 <omp> <script>), 1.4.4 or newer: the relay refuses to start on an older one.
ompInterfaces: omp --version prints omp/<major.minor.patch> when BUN_BE_BUN is not set (init, doctor and rebuild-web read the minor from it)
BUN_BE_BUN=1 <omp> <file.ts> runs the file on omp's embedded Bun
omp config get|set collab.relayUrl and collab.webUrl (init shows the exact lines and runs them only on consent)
The Collab room contract of omp's stand-in relay: GET /r/<roomId>?role=host|guest, envelope peer ids, close codes 4001, 4004, 4009, 4029
Collab links: <web url>/#<relay url>/r/<roomId>.<key>; a loopback ws:// relay in a link is rewritten by the patched web client
collab-web at the release tag (packages/collab-web: index.html, src/lib/link.ts, src/lib/socket.ts), changed by patches/collab-web-<minor>.patch
omp-private-relay.note: The patch applies unchanged to v18.18.0 and v18.18.3; the pinned build is from v18.18.3. A new omp minor needs its own patch file and build.

ompInterfaces: omp collab list --json and omp collab link <instanceId> [--view] --json, JSON version 1
omp config get collab.displayName, collab.relayUrl and collab.webUrl
omp-dashboard.note: The dashboard page is committed in ui-dist and pinned by ui-build.json (SHA-256 per file); it needs no network.

platformsTested: darwin-arm64: macOS 27.2 (MacBook), Bun 1.4.4, Python 3.14.7 and 3.10.20, the real omp 18.18.3: the importer's Bun suite (210 tests), the plugin Python suite (212 tests, one skipped: /proc is Linux only), shellcheck, ruff, the extension-load gate, the whole-cycle smoke (scripts/smoke.sh) with the real embedding model, and the suites again under a macOS sandbox profile that denies reading and writing the real omp, other coding tools' and omp-memory directories

linux-arm64: Ubuntu 24.04.5 container, non-root user, Bun 1.4.4, Python 3.12.3, sqlite3 3.45.1: the Bun suite, the Python suite with lsof and with lsof hidden from PATH (the /proc scan), and the smoke cycle
darwin-arm64: macOS 27.2 (Mac mini), the real omp 18.18.0, Bun 1.4.4, Homebrew Python 3.14: the smoke cycle with `omp-memory setup` run in a scratch home, and the Python suite
platformsNotTested: linux-x64 (including the CUDA download of onnxruntime-node's install script on that platform)
a Linux whose userland is neither GNU nor BSD (busybox, musl)

the real omp binary of versions other than 18.18.0 and 18.18.3 (the library releases 18.18.0 to 18.18.8 pass the structural SQL check, the write test and the importer suite; the write test decides at run time and its refusal names the failing step)
ompInterfaces: The mnemopi bank layout: <agent dir>/memories/mnemopi/banks/<bank>/mnemopi.db, the core tables of omp's Mnemopi library (the importer compares each bank, including its trigger definitions, with a fresh library database and refuses on a difference)

The Mnemopi library, the published npm package @oh-my-pi/pi-mnemopi at exactly the version omp --version prints (found in omp's plugin directory or installed by `omp-memory setup`); the importer refuses any other version and looks for the SQL it relies on in the package and, when it can be scanned, in the omp binary
omp's bank id for a folder (<sanitized basename>-<Bun.hash(folder) in base 36>), a local copy that `doctor` checks against the existing banks, and omp's memory redaction (a local copy)
omp-memory.note: Command line only: no extension. The network is used by `omp-memory setup` (the npm registry for the library; then the embedding runtime from npm and the model from huggingface.co, once), by the embedding step of `import --apply` when setup was skipped, and by the optional export-hindsight when run with --apply. The code under vendor/ is copied byte for byte from a separate source tree (scripts/sync-vendor.sh, OMP_MEMORY_SOURCE_DIR) and a test fails when it drifts. NOTICE lists the code copied from omp and the packages setup downloads.
